explanation: The prophet who conveys God's message and warnings to the people of Israel in the book of Jeremiah.
A day of divine punishment and justice, where God will judge the nations for their sin and disobedience.
A powerful ancient empire that God uses as an instrument to punish Israel and other nations for their sins.
The period during which Israel is to remain under Babylonian rule before returning to their own land.
A symbol of God's anger and judgment against the nations that have acted wickedly and been disobedient toward him.
The king of Babylon whom God appoints to carry out his judgment on Israel and other nations.
The process by which God will restore his people after the Babylonian exile and bring in a time of peace and prosperity.
